description: A disguised hostile actor is admitted through a trusted boundary.

frame.strategy: hide hostile identity inside something the target accepts
frame.turning_point: the defender admits the disguised threat
frame.outcome: the attacker gains access without a direct breach

description: Frequent low-value warnings train receivers to ignore a later real warning.

frame.turning_point: receivers learn to discount the warning channel
frame.outcome: an important later warning receives too little response

description: A team intentionally loses one local contest to improve the total series outcome.

frame.goal: maximize the total result rather than each local result
frame.strategy: accept a local sacrifice and rematch resources globally
frame.turning_point: resources are reassigned across local contests
frame.outcome: a local loss enables a better aggregate result
